report.summary: The orders outbox backlog is caused by the orders service failing to connect to Redpanda, preventing event delivery. This affects downstream services (payments and notifications).
report.likely_cause: Redpanda cluster is not running or unreachable
evidence: Orders logs show disconnection from redpanda:9092
Payments pods have readiness probe failures

suggested_action.detail: Check Redpanda cluster status using k8s_get and verify Redpanda pod health

rule_verdict.cause: orders can't publish its events: check the broker (redpanda)
